cours.description: Introduction to programming and data structures. Students learn to work with classic data structures and to write simple programs.
Study of the file system through the POSIX API (access rights, usage) and introduction to threads: creation, management and synchronization.

This course covers software design principles, UML modeling, and Model-Driven Engineering (MDE), including the creation of software models, and automated code generation from UML and domain-specific languages (DSLs).
